comments.why: Explains why LED Christmas lights look too blue
comments.text: Related to the final photo: you might feel like those Christmas lights feel too blue compared to your nostalgic version of Christmas. This is because LEDs can easily achieve a brighter blue than old incandescent Christmas lights which used color filters on a white light. Technology Connections vid: [VIDEO]

comments.story: It was almost impossible to make the blue LED [video]
comments.why: Series about hating blue LED holiday lights
comments.text: The blue is nicer if you do that. Technology Connections has made 3 videos over the last 5 years mostly centering around how he hates the blue led lights used in holiday lights. I think I've only seen the 2 yr old one, but now that I have I can't unsee it. The blue is just too blue. If you see a set that is all blue instead of multi-color it's unbearable. It's just too blue. White light in blue plastic is where it's at. [LINK] [LINK] [VIDEO]

comments.author: wkjagt
comments.story: It's not just you: Christmas lights look different now, give you headaches
comments.why: Video on unpleasant LED Christmas light colors
comments.text: It’s not just the flickering but also the colour. I really hate the colours of RGB LED Christmas light. I feel no warm Christmas feelings when I see them. Technology Connections made a video about this recently. He described it as it looking “like a gaming PC exploded on your front lawn”. [VIDEO]
